requirements.title: Idempotent canonical evidence linkage
requirements.description: Canonical evidence observations and owner-neutral links are idempotent, queryable, and retain source provenance rather than copying domain authority into the ledger.

validation.notes: Duplicate source observations produce one canonical link.
Run and entity queries expose the same linked evidence record.
The generated Plan Manager Connect seam supplies typed authoritative audit facts.

requirements.title: Exhaustive owner resolution and reconciliation
requirements.description: Every owner index is queried; zero and dual matches remain retryable rather than being hidden by precedence, and verified upstream facts reconcile into the resolved owner.

validation.notes: Unresolved and ambiguous runs cannot be silently assigned.
Plan Manager facts reconcile as authoritative evidence.

requirements.title: Watermark-aware evidence gates
requirements.description: Evidence-dependent mode completion remains pending until every required producer publishes a terminal covering watermark; late verified facts can recover the round.

validation.notes: Absence is not a negative result before producer completion.
